Synopsis:
Lae'zel died in the tutorial. Her body was found on the beach (remember that bodies can be moved though). Player revived her.The flag ORI_LaezelRecruitment_State_CrashVersionInitiated is set upon loading WLD_Main_A, when this version of the recruitment is activated.

Cluster Contexts:
- Laezel_Recruitment_Crash.json: Lae'zel died during the tutorial and her body was recovered on the beach (note: bodies can be moved); the player has since revived her. On revival the player briefly inhabits her perspective—feeling her relief and loathing of the parasite—and learns she knows about the player's infection (you were on the nautiloid and carry a tadpole). Lae'zel immediately pushes to find a Githyanki crèche (she cites Crèche K'liir) as the cure and offers to travel together, while companions like Shadowheart may react with distrust. Loading WLD_Main_A sets the ORI_LaezelRecruitment_State_CrashVersionInitiated flag to mark this crash-version recruitment.
- Laezel_Recruitment.json: You recruit Lae'zel to the party. She tells you the only path to a cure of the tadpole in your head is to make your way to a githyanki creche - a nursery and training grounds.
- PLA_GithChokepoint_ConfrontationLaezel.json: Alternate version of the dragon rider scene at chokepoint. Lae'zel is alive and was never recruited. Player can recruit her after this.

Lae'zel approaches the rider to discover where to find the creche. A cure for the tadpole can be found there - or so she believes. However, the knight is under different orders.
- CHA_LaeZelRecruitment_LaezelDead.json: You helped two tieflings kill a strange creature. (Lae'zel.) You talk to them, and they tell you about a blast they heard. (The ship crash.)
- TUT_LowerDeck_AfterImpFight.json: Companion Lae'zel or (alt gith if Laezel is avatar) will approach the player after spotting the player as she spies on some imps. During the dialogue she has a mindmeld with the player but brushes it aside.
